messages:
tara: Heads up  after the network team's TLS-inspection rollout this morning, several warm-pool GPU nodes in us-west-2 are failing KMS decrypts during bootstrap. join rate dropped ~33%. seeing TLS handshake errors to the privatelink endpoint.

sam: can you paste a log snippet?

tara: snippet from keystore-proxy logs:
```
ERROR keystore.tls region=us-west-2 node=wp-22 msg=\"tls handshake failed: remote error: tls: bad certificate\" dst=vpce-0keystore
ERROR keystore.decrypt node=wp-22 status=500 cause=\"keystore proxy TLS verify failed\" grant=gr-cc77
WARN warmup.join node=wp-22 reason=\"keystore handshake timeout\"
```

diego: TLS-inspection appliances terminate TLS and re-sign with their own certs. privatelink endpoints do strict cert validation so the proxy rejects the inspected connection. this is different to the earlier kms policy issues.

anya: immediate mitigations: 1) bypass TLS inspection for keystore privatelink traffic (fast, firewall/inspection rule), 2) reconfigure keystore-proxy to trust the inspection CA (requires distributing CA certs to fleet, slower and risky), 3) revert inspection rollout (blast radius). prefer (1) for minimal risk.

hassan: note from security: bypassing inspection reduces visibility. if we do (1) we need an approved temporary exception ticket and compensating controls (increase audit retention on keystore logs, session capture). low infra cost but SOC signoff required.

tara: timeline proposal: (a) sam opens inspection-exception CR and applies bypass for vpce-0keystore (0-20m), (b) validate warm-pool joins (20-80m), (c) open followups for CA distribution option and longer-term design.

sam: creating CR now. rule: inspection-bypass: src=warmpool-subnets dst=vpce-0keystore protocol=TLS tag=keystore-bypass TTL=2h. applying to staging as canary.

ops-bot: INC-9021 created for keystore TLS failures. Linked CR NET-1178 (inspection-bypass). Reminder: security approval required if TTL>4h.

diego: staging canary result: bypass applied, keystore TLS handshakes succeed, warm-pool join recovered to ~98% in staging. patching prod in ~10m.

hassan: sec pre-approves temporary bypass for 2h with audit annotation `keystore-tls-exception`. increase keystore audit retention to 60d for this incident.

sam: applied bypass in prod. warm-pool join back to baseline ~96% within 12 minutes. monitoring.

tara: followups to capture: add automated probe that detects TLS inspection for privatelink endpoints during policy rollouts, add CI warm-pool bootstrap test that validates keystore mutual TLS, document runbook steps for inspection bypass and SOC approval flow.

hassan: also file a design ticket to evaluate long-term options: (A) trust chain distribution to keystore proxies, (B) mark internal vpce ranges as inspection-exempt by default, or (C) move keystore control plane to a network path that preserves original certs. security prefers (A) or (C) after risk assessment.

ops-bot: INC-9021 updated: status=mitigating, mitigation=NET-1178 (inspection-bypass), est-resolve=+3h.

tara: I'll draft the postmortem and assign followups. closing this thread when NET-1178 removed and audit-retention verified. thanks all. :thumbsup:
